notes.title: Update v0.07.09 - Performance Options
notes.notes:
Here's a small update, mainly to help with performance.

Changes:

Vsync is now enabled by default (I totally thought it was already 🙃). This will help prevent excessive GPU usage. There is a setting to turn it off now too though.

Added options to decrease or fully remove the production visual (flying weapons). This should help performance even more if needed.

Added an option to make the production visual "mixed" instead of each weapon being on its own line. No performance gains here, you can just pick which one you like more

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470032/1c317220bb86e9a7ff509fe1591fe9cea2041cef.gif"]

notes.title: ⭐🌟Prestige Update v0.07.08🌟⭐
notes.notes:
⭐🌟⭐🌟⭐🌟⭐🌟⭐🌟⭐🌟⭐The Prestige Update is now live!! Try it out!
This update adds a lot! New systems, reworked systems, way better performance, and even a new weapon to produce.


[previewyoutube="ScHHNwed8A0;full"][/previewyoutube]

New Features:
🌟 Prestige! Restart your progress, but with new, very powerful prestige upgrades. We have a lot more coming, but these will change how you play the game.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470032/6bb44a2452906c47a48c8d1e0b11fc295842e49b.png"]

😱 Fear! A new system to engage with, that will increase the sell prices of all weapons as you boost fear higher.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470032/1b9108b56fd74c9e575ba69510a894849dd42da0.gif"]



🪙 Golden Weapons! An idle game staple. Each weapon produced has a small chance to be golden. When clicked, it’ll boost the sell price for that weapon. This can be stacked with the boost from the Fear system

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470032/f4dbcdc4b97daf9c9a29fee91378f8d1569460ce.gif"]

🧪 Research Rework! Research now gives you the choice of 2 options to pick from. This will make research more interesting, and allow for prioritizing different builds.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470032/b2919f10f21024dd2637380a1b289544c12dae9c.gif"]

🚙 Jeeps! The next weapon to make.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470032/54e730f2ea982916373f8871848e37ec58fb105f.gif"]



⚒️ All Materials Production Unlocked! Automate your entire supply chain.

🎛️ Performance Improvements! Lots of improvements here, the game should run a lot better.



Also, we’re running 2 contests for this demo update in our discord!
[olist]
A randomly drawn sweepstakes where the winner gets to name an upgrade in the game. Post a screenshot of your end-screen from the demo to enter

A speed-run contest, where whoever posts the fastest time to beat the demo gets an achievement named after them. Instructions and rules can be found here on the submission form.
[/olist]
More details on both in our discord, join here: https://discord.gg/unp9BR69cA

notes.title: v0.04.3 Bugfix
notes.notes:
Another small update for y'all

1 new feature: the Progressive Press sticks around once you've unlocked automated presses, so you can still click as much as you'd like even with automated bullet production.

Bugs fixed:

 A bug that didn't allow some players to launch the game (or would crash shortly after launch) has been fixed, and old save files should work again
 You can no longer hold down a production button, click on another button, and have that production button still held down
 Grenades sometimes wouldn't let you press the explosive button, but that is now fixed

notes.title: v0.04.2 Bugfix
notes.notes:
Massive shout out to Real Civil Engineer and others for making videos about this game and driving a ton of new players to try it out!! And big thanks to everyone who has played the demo, shared their feedback, and reported bugs! I really appreciate all of you.

Small bugfix update to address some issues found by newer players:

 Production progress bars have a set animation once they reach a certain speed, to hopefully stop burn-in occurring on some players screens
 Added a new audio slider to control the production sound effects (bullet, grenade, and gun clinks mainly) separate from the other sound effects
 Clarified you can click-and-hold the Single Stage Press and other upgrades
 Fixed saving and loading profit and expense rates


Known issues:

 The game rarely crashes and then won't let the player relaunch it. This can typically be resolved by deleting the save files with the following process:
 Search %appdata% using the Search button on your taskbar. Then go to Godot -> app_userdata -> MilitaryIncrementalComplex. Then delete the one or two (there might be a backup) save_game_byte_array files there and try running the game again

notes.title: v0.04.1 Bugfix
notes.notes:
Huge thanks to everyone who has playtested, wishlisted, and reported bugs!! The demo launch has gone very well, so I'm very excited to keep working on the game! Please report anymore bugs you find in the Steam discussions here or the discord here.

New Features:

 Added an option to switch between windowed and fullscreen


Bug fixes:

 Automatic grenade production now works correctly after loading
 Buy and sell amounts now load their saved values correctly
 Fixed the game closing on boot up for some players
